craft_notes: Sthāyin: māyā-in-maya (the paradox-verse: māyā's END is māyā's OWN truth — end-by-end, then Śiva's truth saves: the layering kept exactly: BY-her-end / BY-her-truth / BY-ŚIVA-truth / world-truth / own-truth). Rows: row 1 (four-by-clause chain uncut). Close: own-formed (svakṛti — made of own-making: self-authorship as final word). Rejected: 'illusion dissolves into truth' simplifying — killed: end-and-truth both kept (they coexist: the end IS a truth OF hers); 'māya is illusion' doctrine — killed: māyā's own truth kept (she has a truth: the verse's whole point).

lines: By māyā's end — māyā's own truth: By Śiva's truth:
the world's truth known — own truth, own-formed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: indriyadvārakaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisaṃgamam | itīndriyāṇi saṃtyajya svasthaḥ svātmani vartate

reads_against.argmap: What happens to the senses? → Leaving the sense-doored meetings, one abides self-abiding in own self.
c1_essence: Senses left: self-abiding abides in own self.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with śānta (wonder settled into stillness)
